title: ComputeTarget
description: A configured remote compute target. Credentials are referenced, never stored.

target_id.title: TargetId
target_id.description: Compute target identifier (lowercase slug). `local` is reserved for this machine.

kind.title: TargetKind
kind.description: `ssh`: a worker host reached over SSH (usually on the tailnet). `slurm`: a cluster login node reached over SSH; jobs go through `sbatch`. `runpod`: pods through the Runpod REST API. `colab`: notebook export only (no unattended execution).

ssh.title: SshConfig
ssh.description: How the coordinator reaches a host. Uses the user's SSH keys and config.

host.description: `[user@]host`, for example a MagicDNS name on the tailnet.

command.description: argv prefix used instead of `ssh` (tests, or a wrapper). The host and remote command are appended.

supervisor.description: How an `ssh` target keeps the worker alive: a systemd user service (restarted on failure; `auto` picks it when available) or a detached `setsid nohup` process.

drain_sec.description: How long the worker keeps delivering inside the allocation after the job exits. The rest is drained from the login node on reconnection. Default 300.

api_key_env.description: Coordinator environment variable holding the Runpod API key. Never stored.

volume_gb.description: Pod volume mounted at /workspace (default 20). The worker directory lives there, so a stopped pod keeps its spool and a drain restarts it.

deliver_deadline_sec.description: How long a pod keeps trying to deliver after the job exits before it stops itself (default 3600). A stopped pod bills storage only; its spool is delivered by a drain (pod restart).

tailscale_authkey_secret.description: Name of a Runpod secret holding a Tailscale auth key; the pod joins the tailnet to reach the worker listener. Referenced, never copied.

cents_per_hour.description: Rate card for estimates (provider billing lags).

serve_command.description: Research endpoints: the shell command that serves the model in `$MODEL_DIR` on `$PORT`. Default `python3 -m mlflow models serve -m "$MODEL_DIR" -h 0.0.0.0 -p "$PORT" --env-manager local` (the image needs MLflow and the model's dependencies).

serve_port.description: Research endpoints: the port the server listens on (default 8080).

live.description: Put the attempt's worker credentials in the notebook so the runtime delivers live. Only when `worker_url` is reachable from Colab; the notebook is then a secret. Default false: results come back with `remote import`.

deliver_deadline_sec.description: With `live`, how long the notebook keeps delivering after the job (default 120).

work_dir.description: Where bundles are unpacked on the worker. Default `~/.ablationkit-worker`.

worker_url.description: URL workers on this target use to reach the coordinator's worker listener (a tailnet name or a gateway). Default: settings `remote.worker_url`.

ntfy.title: NtfyConfig
ntfy.description: Workers post terminal status, disk pressure and credential problems here, independently of the coordinator. Passed in the worker's credentials file, not the bundle.

token_env.description: Coordinator environment variable with an ntfy access token.

paid.description: Submissions cost money. Human submissions must accept the estimate; agents may submit only when the project policy allows `jobs.submit_remote` on this target.

created_at.title: Timestamp
created_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with a `Z` suffix and optional fractional seconds.

updated_at.title: Timestamp
updated_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with a `Z` suffix and optional fractional seconds.
